name: codex-remote-ssh
description: Safely configure and verify a Terminalbox SSH host for the official Codex app.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to a persistent Terminalbox pane.
interface.longDescription: Verify the Terminalbox SSH gateway, create a bounded host entry, test the remote Codex login shell, and connect it in the official Codex app.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $configure-codex-remote-ssh to connect my Codex app to a Terminalbox pane over SSH.
